email_subject: Application - Intern Communications at MedTech Europe
email_body:
Dear Director Communications,

I am writing to apply for the Intern Communications role at MedTech Europe. I have built and launched a ~600-page website for a pharmacists' association, and I run Google Ads campaigns that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks in a self-funded test. I also write and edit content for newsletters and digital platforms, and I am fluent in English.

I am drawn to MedTech Europe because you shape the EU healthcare landscape, and I want to use my digital skills to support your communications team. I have experience with WordPress, Mailchimp, SharePoint and the Office Suite, and I am comfortable monitoring media and creating reports.

I live in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Brussels office is no problem. I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

Dear Director Communications,

When I built a ~600-page website for a pharmacists' association, I learned that clear, consistent content is what makes a digital platform work. That same principle drives my Google Ads campaigns, where I earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks by choosing buyer-intent keywords and writing focused landing pages. I want to bring that mix of content creation and digital savvy to MedTech Europe's Communications team.

MedTech Europe's role in shaping EU healthcare policy appeals to me because I have seen how complex subjects need clear messages. At Episto, I run keyword research and SEO for consulting and e-commerce clients, and I report on rankings, traffic and CTR using Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console. I have also built kxp.be single-handedly in WordPress, in English, Dutch and French, and I support a WooCommerce webshop with product content and conversion pages. These experiences taught me to edit content for newsletters, manage digital platforms and keep databases up to date.

I am fluent in English and comfortable with Mailchimp, SharePoint, WordPress and the Office Suite. I live in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Brussels office is no problem.

In the first weeks, I would familiarise myself with your media monitoring process and newsletter schedule, then start sourcing and creating content for your social media channels. I would also ensure all databases and documents are up to date. I would welcome a conversation to discuss how I can support your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
